Title: API Definition
QuestionDetail: What does API stand for in software development?
AnswerDetails: API stands for Application Programming Interface, which is a set of protocols and tools for building software applications that allow different programs to communicate with each other.

Title: Python Creator
QuestionDetail: Which programming language was created by Guido van Rossum?
AnswerDetails: Guido van Rossum created Python in the late 1980s, naming it after the British comedy series Monty Python's Flying Circus.

Title: iPhone Launch
QuestionDetail: What year was the first iPhone released?
AnswerDetails: The first iPhone was released by Apple in 2007, revolutionizing the smartphone industry with its touchscreen interface and app ecosystem.

Title: HTTP Definition
AnswerDetails: HTTP stands for HyperText Transfer Protocol, which is the foundation of data communication on the World Wide Web.
